features.name: Hottest temperature of the year, averaged over the years

outcomeSources.title: USDA NASS Quick Stats, SURVEY, county level, AREA HARVESTED and YIELD, 2019–2023
outcomeSources.note: Yields converted from bu/acre (56, 60, 32 and 60 lb per bushel for maize, soybean, oats and wheat) and short tons/acre (alfalfa hay) to t/ha by scripts/twins_outcomes.py.

outcomeSources.title: Eurostat apro_cpnhr, crop production in national humidity by NUTS 2 region, area and harvested production, 2019–2023
outcomeSources.note: Yield = harvested production / area for each year, then the mean (our calculation). Germany: figures of the NUTS 1 Land.
